stageNote: Authored after all four scopes reached Done, from the Gherkin blocks already present in scopes.md. Every scenarioId, title, scopeId and linkedTests value is TRANSCRIBED from those blocks and from the named selftest assertions they were satisfied by, rather than composed here. This manifest reports the plan that was executed and adds no claim of its own. The two Scope 3 scenarios gained faithful DoD items during the closing audit; their linked assertions predate that edit and were not written for it.
keyShapeNote: This manifest keys scenarios on `scenarioId`, matching every pre-existing manifest in this repository and the literal key Gate G057's counter reads. The framework's scenario-state resolver keys on `id` instead; that divergence is a known framework-side inconsistency recorded against spec 026 and is NOT re-litigated here — following the majority shape keeps this artifact consistent with its neighbours.
businessScenarioMapping: SCN-BUG009-001 through SCN-BUG009-008 are the eight scenarios carrying a Gherkin block in scopes.md, one per behaviour each scope actually delivered. DISC-009-004 (the scheduled tier-a.yml job cannot publish the payload) is deliberately NOT expressed as a scenario: it is an OPEN gap, and a Gherkin block here is the regression contract for behaviour that exists. Writing it as a scenario would force either a false Definition-of-Done item or a permanently red gate. It is recorded as prose in Scope 4 and as the one still-open finding in state.json. The runtime assertion identifiers under linkedTests keep their pre-existing SCN-BUG009-R1-* / R4 names and are deliberately not renumbered to match this manifest, because renaming a landed assertion to fit a later artifact breaks the trace it exists to provide.

scenarios.title: The producer carries no opinion of its own
A severe reading that has not persisted does not interrupt the reader
A generation whose observed state warrants attention publishes an item
A genuinely quiet generation publishes an empty feed
A gate result is never synthesized to satisfy the validator
The suite fails when no production module produces a gate result
An adversarial empty tier is not mistaken for a quiet one
A refused feed does not read as a calm one
